bindingOwner: Trusted OEM selected-source adapter, not untrusted frame metadata or an application
clockMeaning: Observed world-frame time and unchanged sensor time are distinct; no interpolation, host/guest clock subtraction or pixel-time accuracy claim
deliveryAgeMeaning: Receiver monotonic time since the current frame was admitted; not capture freshness or capture-to-display latency
composition: Independent Vision-only OEM platform component; no VDP, Brake/Tire payload or VDP-slot adoption
lifecycle: Native OEM/Aos lifecycle only after distinct target/resource/SELinux integration is qualified; core supplies no installer or lifecycle manager
